## Overview

This repository contains a custom Docker image for Elasticsearch 6.2.4 that comes with Japanese language analysis plugins pre-installed. The image is based on the official Elasticsearch OSS (Open Source Software) distribution and includes ICU and Kuromoji analysis plugins for enhanced text processing capabilities.

## Features

- **Elasticsearch 6.2.4**: Based on the official Elasticsearch OSS distribution
- **Japanese Language Support**: Pre-installed Kuromoji plugin for Japanese text analysis
- **ICU Analysis**: International Components for Unicode plugin for advanced text processing
- **Docker Integration**: Easy deployment and testing with Docker
- **Automated Testing**: CI/CD pipeline with CircleCI for build and test automation
- **Single Node Configuration**: Optimized for development and testing environments

## Installation

### Prerequisites

- Docker installed on your system
- Make utility (optional, for using Makefile commands)

### Building the Image

```bash
# Clone the repository
git clone <repository-url>
cd docker-elasticsearch

# Build the Docker image
make build
```

Or build manually:

```bash
docker build -t veltra/elasticsearch .
```

## Usage

### Running Elasticsearch Container

```bash
# Run the container with single node discovery
docker run -p 9200:9200 -e "discovery.type=single-node" -d --name elasticsearch veltra/elasticsearch
```

### Testing the Installation

```bash
# Run the test suite
make test
```

This will:
1. Build the Docker image
2. Start the Elasticsearch container
3. Wait for the service to be ready
4. Test the connection using curl

### API Endpoints

The Elasticsearch instance will be available at `http://localhost:9200` with the following API groups:

| Endpoint            | Method | Description                        |
| ------------------- | ------ | ---------------------------------- |
| `/`                 | GET    | Cluster information                |
| `/_cluster/health`  | GET    | Cluster health status              |
| `/_nodes`           | GET    | Node information                   |
| `/_cat/indices`     | GET    | List all indices                   |
| `/{index}/_search`  | POST   | Search documents                   |
| `/{index}/_analyze` | POST   | Analyze text with Japanese plugins |

### Environment Variables

The following environment variables can be configured:

| Variable                 | Default       | Description                          |
| ------------------------ | ------------- | ------------------------------------ |
| `discovery.type`         | `single-node` | Discovery type for single node setup |
| `ELASTICSEARCH_USERNAME` | -             | Username for authentication          |
| `ELASTICSEARCH_PASSWORD` | -             | Password for authentication          |

### Example Usage with Japanese Text Analysis

```bash
# Test Japanese text analysis
curl -X POST "localhost:9200/_analyze" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "analyzer": "kuromoji",
    "text": "東京都に住んでいます"
  }'
```
